micro-ecc, by Kenneth MacKay, BSD 2-clause license.
https://github.com/kmackay/micro-ecc — tag v1.1, the portable C sources only (no `asm_*.inc`).

The receiver builds its TLS certificate with it. Qt's TLS backends don't share an API for creating a certificate, and the macOS build of Qt doesn't use OpenSSL. The license is in `LICENSE.txt` and in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
